Set to true to enable Key Vault cert binding for RDS roles.
Name of the existing Key Vault containing the RDS certificate.
Resource group of the existing Key Vault.
Full Key Vault secret URI for the certificate, e.g. https://myvault.vault.azure.net/secrets/rdscert. The cert policy MUST have exportable=true.
Subject (or substring) used by the broker DSC to locate the cert in LocalMachine\My, e.g. "CN=rdsgw.contoso.com".

Public FQDN clients type into Remote Desktop / RD Web (and what the cert Subject/SAN must match). Leave empty to use the LB DNS-label hostname (`<dnsLabel>.<region>.cloudapp.azure.com`) — only viable with a self-signed cert because a public CA will refuse to issue for `cloudapp.azure.com`. For production set this to a hostname you control, e.g. `rds.contoso.com`, and create a CNAME from that hostname to the LB FQDN after the first deploy.
